reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0200 is a mutual freedom-of-action provision confirming each party may enter similar agreements, which is the opposite of a non-compete on Customer.

The only Customer-side prohibitions cited are a standard no-resale limit (p0190) and ordinary license-scope boundaries (p0202); neither restricts the businesses we operate or the products we buy or build, so they do not trigger the NONCOMPETE presence rule.

Correctly no redline and no comment for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the originals and the deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') passes.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes the searched terms and the non-restrictive nature of the geographic-scope clause (limits IBM's delivery obligations, not Customer's territory).
